# Halliday Architects

> Residential architecture practice in Ocean City, New Jersey, working along the
> New Jersey shore since 2013. Led personally by Christopher and Shannon
> Halliday, both registered architects and LEED accredited professionals. Work
> covers new custom homes, additions, renovations and interiors, together with
> code analysis, permit coordination and construction administration. The site is
> a portfolio of the practice's built work — it is not a real estate listings
> platform and does not publish prices or MLS data.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of the practice, services, and featured projects.
- [About](/about): The practice and how it works.
- [Our Team](/team): The people behind the practice.
- [Services](/services): Architectural consultation, new homes, additions and renovations, interiors and kitchens, code analysis and permits, construction administration.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of completed projects.
- [Contact](/contact): Inquiry form, phone, email, and office address.
